name: prompticon
description: Adds customizable quick replies and reusable prompt templates to supported AI chat websites.

scripts.pack:chrome: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$version = (Get-Content manifest.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version; Compress-Archive -Path manifest.json, site-settings.js, command-palette.js, smart-detection.js, profile-packs.js, long-press.js, template-variables.js, onboarding.js, content.js, content.css, popup.html, popup.js, assets -DestinationPath ('prompticon-chrome-v' + $version + '.zip') -Force"
scripts.check:firefox: npm test && npm run lint:firefox && npm run pack:firefox

author: QAInsights
